title: Creditor notification
description: Tells a creditor of the death and asks for the amount owing.
guidance:
Write to a creditor of the deceased (a utility, a card provider, a lender, a hospital). We act for the executors (or the person applying for the grant).

- Tell them of the death: the deceased's full name and date of death, and any account or reference number the matter's documents give.
- Ask for a statement of the amount owing at the date of death, and to send future correspondence about the estate to us.
- Ask them to close the account or stop any regular charges, where that applies.
- Don't admit the debt, promise payment or say when it will be paid: say only that the executors will consider their claim with the estate's other debts.
